analysis:
【今日摘要】
今天市場情緒波動較大，受中國DeepSeek事件影響，美國股市大幅下跌，納斯達克指數領先跌幅，AI基礎設施製造商大幅下跌，Nvidia跌幅達16%。另一方面，CoreWeave股價大漲14%，因收入翻倍迎接AI基礎設施需求加速。另外，Ryanair與Google雲端簽下五年合約，擴大航空公司AI運用。

【結語】
今日市場情緒波動較大，投資者需要謹慎觀察市場變化。投資者應該注意自己的風險承受能力，並且保持投資組合的多元化。投資者也應該注意公司的財務狀況和未來的展望。

【精選個股】
NVDA - NVIDIA -_CoreWeave的收入翻倍，推動Nvidia的AI業務快速增長。
LMT - Lumentum - 公司見到銷售量超過兩倍，人工智慧需求大增。
SMCI - Super Micro - 公司近期已經在華爾街展現出改善盈利趨勢的跡象。
風險提醒：投資者應該注意公司的財務狀況和未來的展望，並且保持投資組合的多元化。

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Stocks Pause Before CPI Inflation; 3 Nvidia Partners Lead Earnings Movers Late
items.summary: The major market indexes pulled back amid higher oil prices and upcoming CPI inflation data. Nvidia partners Lumentum, CoreWeave, Super Micro reported late.
items.zh_title: 道瓊未來指數：股市暫停前待CPI通膨數據；3家Nvidia夥伴晚間公布業績
items.zh_point: 道瓊未來指數暫停上揚，受油價上漲和即將公布的CPI通膨數據影響。Nvidia夥伴Lumentum、CoreWeave和Super Micro晚間公布業績。

items.title: CRWV Stock Rallies 13% After-Hours — AI Compute Demand Has Pushed CoreWeave Revenue To More Than Double
items.summary: CoreWeave beat second-quarter top- and bottom-line expectations as soaring artificial intelligence computing demand pushed quarterly revenue up 112% to $2.58 billion and prompted the company to raise its full-year guidance.
items.zh_title: CoreWeave 股價在盤後大漲 13% — 人工智慧計算需求推動 CoreWeave 收入超過翻倍
items.zh_point: CoreWeave 的第二季度營收達到 2.58 億美元，高達 112%，遠超預期，公司因此提高了全年財務指標。

items.title: NuScale Power Looks Like a Generational Wealth-Building Opportunity Right Now
items.summary: NuScale Power could become a much larger company if rising power demand translates into a repeatable commercial business.
items.zh_title: NuScale Power 看似一項世代財富建設機會
items.zh_point: NuScale Power 有可能成為一個龐大的公司，如果電力需求持續增長，商業化業務也能夠穩定運作。

items.title: Why OppFi Stock Swooned by Almost 25% Today
items.summary: The specialty lender posted a displeasing quarterly earnings report.
items.zh_title: OppFi 股票暴跌近 25%：專業貸款公司財報令人失望
items.zh_point: OppFi 股票今日大幅下跌近 25%，原因是該公司發布的季度財報令人失望。

items.title: Ryanair signs five-year Google Cloud deal, expands use of AI in airline operations
items.summary: Ryanair said on Wednesday it would deploy Google's Gemini AI tools and DeepMind models ‌across its operations under a new five-year cloud partnership, using ‌the technology to help manage crew scheduling and make operational decisions.  Ryanair, Europe's largest airline ​by passenger numbers, said it would roll out Alphabet's Google Workspace and Google Cloud services to 35,000 employees across its network, supporting its efforts towards a goal of carrying 300 million passengers annually by 2034.
items.zh_title: Ryanair與Google雲端簽下五年合約，擴大航空公司AI運用
items.zh_point: Ryanair與Google簽下五年雲端合約，將Google的AI工具與深度學習模型應用於航空公司的運作，包括飛行員排班和作業決策等，同時將Google Workspace和雲端服務推廣給35,000名員工，為2034年達到每年3億名乘客的目標做準備。

items.title: Wednesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
items.summary: Uncertainty around Iran and a decline in tech stocks pulled the S&P 500 down on Tuesday. Tune into CNBC on Wednesday for CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator.
items.zh_title: 星期三的大宗股票新聞：下一交易日市場可能受哪些因素影響
items.zh_point: 伊朗局勢不明朗和科技股下跌，讓標準普爾500指數星期二下跌。星期三，財經頻道CNBC將播出CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator的專訪。

items.title: GM reaches up to $4.5 billion parts deal designed to avoid supply chain troubles
items.summary: The deal follows years of global automotive supply chain issues for GM and other companies.
items.zh_title: GM 農夫山泉達到 450 億美元零件交易，旨在避免供應鏈問題
items.zh_point: 通用汽車（GM）與零件供應商達成 450 億美元交易，旨在解決全球汽車供應鏈問題，該問題已經困擾 GM 和其他公司多年。

items.title: Trump administration ends Medicaid, CHIP funding for gender-affirming care for children
items.summary: Federal dollars in the two health insurance programs would not go toward gender-affirming care, but states could still cover the treatments.
items.zh_title: 特朗普政府終止兒童性別認同治療的醫療補助
items.zh_point: 美國特朗普政府決定終止聯邦醫療補助（Medicaid）和兒童醫療保險計劃（CHIP）中的兒童性別認同治療費用補助，但州政府仍可自行覆蓋相關治療費用。

items.title: CoreWeave’s stock soars as earnings show major AI momentum
